translations.web: When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
translations.bsb: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.
translations.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
translations.asv: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of the man, passeth through waterless places, seeking rest, and findeth it not.
